name: IsCompanion.extend_coe
statement:
lemma IsCompanion.extend_coe (h : IsCompanion e a b) (x : A) :
    (h.extend ⟨x, le_closure_insert x.2⟩ : β) = e x

name: IsCompanion.extend_self
statement:
lemma IsCompanion.extend_self (h : IsCompanion e a b) :
    (h.extend ⟨a, self_mem_closure_insert⟩ : β) = b

name: IsCompanion.extend_spec
statement:
lemma IsCompanion.extend_spec (h : IsCompanion e a b)
    (x : (closure (insert a (A : Set α)) : BooleanSubalgebra α)) :
    ∃ y z : A, (x : α) = ((y : α) ⊓ a) ⊔ ((z : α) ⊓ aᶜ) ∧
      (h.extend x : β) = ((e y : β) ⊓ b) ⊔ ((e z : β) ⊓ bᶜ)

name: IsCompanion.mapRep_eq
IsCompanion.mapRep_mapRep
statement: lemma IsCompanion.mapRep_mapRep (h : IsCompanion e a b) : h.symm.mapRep (h.mapRep u) = u

name: IsCompanion.mapRep_mono
statement:
lemma IsCompanion.mapRep_mono (h : IsCompanion e a b) (hu : u₁ ≤ u₂) :
    h.mapRep u₁ ≤ h.mapRep u₂

name: IsCompanion.map_le_map
IsCompanion.symm
statement: lemma IsCompanion.symm (h : IsCompanion e a b) : IsCompanion e.symm b a

name: IsCompanion.val_mapRep
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsCompanion.val_mapRep (h : IsCompanion e a b) : (h.mapRep u : β) =
    ((e (insertRepPair u).1 : β) ⊓ b) ⊔ ((e (insertRepPair u).2 : β) ⊓ bᶜ)

name: exists_companionPiece
statement:
lemma exists_companionPiece [DenselyOrdered β] (e : A ≃o B) (a : α) (p : A) :
    ∃ c : β, c ≤ (e p : β) ∧ (c = ⊥ ↔ (p : α) ⊓ a = ⊥) ∧ (c = (e p : β) ↔ (p : α) ≤ a)

name: exists_isCompanion
statement:
theorem exists_isCompanion [Nontrivial β] [DenselyOrdered β]
    (hA : (A : Set α).Finite) (e : A ≃o B) (a : α) :
    ∃ b : β, IsCompanion e a b

name: BooleanSubalgebra.coe_bot_finite
statement: lemma BooleanSubalgebra.coe_bot_finite : ((⊥ : BooleanSubalgebra α) : Set α).Finite

name: iso_of_countable_atomless
statement:
theorem iso_of_countable_atomless
    [Countable α] [Nontrivial α] [DenselyOrdered α]
    [Countable β] [Nontrivial β] [DenselyOrdered β] :
    Nonempty (α ≃o β)

name: small_preimage_of_injective
statement:
theorem small_preimage_of_injective (f : α → β) (h : Function.Injective f) (s : Set β) [Small.{u} s] :
    Small.{u} (f ⁻¹' s)
